description: Fictional people, projects and relationships for a UXD leadership demonstration. No enterprise records or live integrations.

files.people.csv: People, reporting structure and discipline capacity
files.projects.csv: Projects, ownership, contributors, priorities and dependencies
files.workspace.json: Equivalent full Plan object with revision 0; a reference for adapters, not a browser JSON upload

identity: Use person and project IDs for all relationships. Display names and legacy owner labels do not resolve identity.
persistence: Generating these files does not change saved data. The in-app example remains session-only. Import CSV files into a separate demo database when persistence is needed.
